facts.fact: NAM-CSIRT's 2025 landscape report says that in the absence of a cybersecurity law in Namibia it looks to the government to expedite the Cybercrime Bill and related regulations, and recommends finalising and enacting the Cybercrime, Data Protection and CII regulations; the document carries no issue date, so its published date is used.
